Hugues Moutouh, the senior state representative in the Centre-Val de Loire region, is under investigation by prosecutors in Paris for reportedly passing on information about judicial investigations into Marine Le Pen’s party, according to multiple French outlets including Le Monde, which first reported on the allegations . The investigation was opened in July and Moutouh has not been formally charged, Le Monde reported. Civil servants are bound by professional confidentiality, and sharing information on a judicial investigation is also an offense under French law.
